name: Microsoft Power Automate
summary: Microsoft's cloud and desktop automation service with RPA and Copilot features.
description: Power Automate is part of Microsoft Power Platform. It automates workflows across cloud apps, systems and websites, and includes robotic process automation for desktop tasks, process mining and Copilot-assisted flow creation. A 30-day free trial is available. The Premium plan costs $15 per user per month paid yearly; Process and Hosted Process licences for unattended bots cost $150 and $215 per bot per month.

howToUse.title: Open Microsoft Power Automate
howToUse.description: Open Microsoft Power Automate on the Power Platform site and start the 30-day trial, or sign in if you already have access.

howToUse.title: Describe a cloud flow with Copilot
howToUse.description: Use Copilot-assisted creation to describe the workflow in natural language. Power Automate automates it across cloud apps, systems and websites.

howToUse.title: Add desktop robotic automation
howToUse.description: For a desktop task, build a robotic process automation flow, either attended or unattended.

howToUse.title: Mine the process, then pick a licence
howToUse.description: Run task and process mining to see where the work stalls. The Premium plan costs $15 per user per month paid yearly. Process and Hosted Process licences for unattended bots cost $150 and $215 per bot per month.
